title: The Emperor’s New Clothes in Benchmarking? A Rigorous Examination of Mitigation Strategies for LLM Benchmark Data Contamination
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical problem of data contamination in LLM benchmarks and proposes metrics to evaluate mitigation strategies. While it uses MMLU (which includes ethics topics) as a test case and briefly discusses a moral philosophy question in the appendix as a qualitative example of failure, the core component of the research is benchmarking methodology, not religion, morals, or ethics.
